sn7.14:1.2: Atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇa-mahāsālo lūkho lūkhapā- puraṇo yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn7.14:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyam vītisāretvā ekam antam nisīdi || 3. Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ brāhmaṇa-mahāsālaṃ Bhagavā etad avocā || ||
sn7.14:1.4: Kinnu tvaṃ brāhmaṇa lūkho lūkhapāpuraṇo ti || || 4.
sn7.14:1.5: Idha me bho Gotama cattaro puttā ||
sn7.14:1.6: te maṃ dārehi sampuccha gharā nikkhamentīti || || 5.
sn7.14:1.7: Tena hi tvaṃ brāhmaṇa imā gāthāyo pariyāpuṇitvā sabhāyaṃ mahājanakāye sannipatite puttesu ca sannisinnesu bhāsassu || ||
sn7.14:7.1: Atha kho so brāhmaṇa-mahāsālo Bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo pariyāpuṇitvā sabhāyaṃ mahājanakāye sannipatite puttesu ca sannisinnesu abhāsi || ||
sn7.14:13.1: Atha kho naṃ brāhmaṇa-mahāsālaṃ puttā gharaṃ netvā nahāpetvā paccekaṃ dussayugena acchādesuṃ || || 8.
sn7.14:13.2: Atha kho so brāhmaṇa-mahāsālo ekaṃ dussayugam ādāya yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn7.14:13.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 9. Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho brāhmaṇa-mahāsālo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.14:13.4: Mayam bho Gotama brāhmaṇā nāma ācariyassa ācariyadhanam pariyesāma ||
sn7.14:13.5: patiggaṇhatu me bhavaṃ Gotamo ācariyadhanan ti || || 10.
sn7.14:13.7: Atha kho so brāhmaṇa-mahāsālo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.14:13.9: upāsakaṃ mam bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti || || 1. Sāvatthi nidānaṃ || || 2.
